_lesson: The prologue under the Instagram button is told like Instagram stories: each chapter is one 'slide'. Change the words freely. 'line' is the big text, 'small' is the line under it. The last chapter shows the 'choices' buttons; each one links somewhere on the site (#quiz-wedding opens the wedding quiz, #shop jumps to the collection).

chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.small: Yours starts here. Tap to turn the page.

chapters.label: Chapter one
chapters.line: It begins with a look in the mirror.
chapters.small: Amber for warm days. Pearl for big ones. Zircon when you want the room to notice.

chapters.label: Chapter two
chapters.small: Ours is made for a Tuesday, a chai date, an 8am class, and the wedding too.

chapters.label: Chapter three
chapters.line: Your aura isn't loud or quiet.
chapters.small: It's yours. We just help it shine.
